title: Alarm sounds continuously
symptom: The app's alarm sounds continuously instead of sounding once then repeating only as configured by the 'Re-raise every x minutes if unacknowledged' setting. Clicking the notification or selecting a snooze time does not stop the alarm. One user reports the continuous sound only occurs on alerts with both 'Override Phone Silent' and 'Force Speaker' enabled.
fix: Upgrade to a xDrip release after April 12, 2022; the reporter confirmed the issue appears fixed in later releases. No exact code fix is described in the thread.
evidence_quote: This appears to be fixed in later releases. Thanks for the support!
